mechanism: A persistent 'notes' dict injected into the python-tool sandbox globals, surviving across tool calls within one game, advertised to the model via ONE clause in the python tool's JSON schema description ('notes is a dict that persists across tool calls within this game; everything else is ephemeral'). Intended to give the agent a working memory channel it currently lacks.
summary: P1 seed 1 (canivel/arc3-p1-notes-eval v1) COMPLETED 2026-08-22 and was never pulled; pulled and read 2026-08-23 at zero GPU. The patch APPLIED -- the kernel wrote out its patched source tree (p1_patched/ARC3-Inference/) containing all three [notes] prints and the swapped tool description verbatim -- and the run was healthy (25 games, 1502 actions, all state=gave_up on the 7920s clock). But the model referenced the injected namespace only 5 times across all 25 per-game transcripts, against ~400 acting turns measured by the validated cadence instrument (16.0 acting turns/game median x 25) = ~1.3% write-rate, or 3.4% against the most conservative denominator (148 <tool_call> markers). The sealed bar is 30%. Descriptive outcome, explicitly NOT read as a verdict (seed 1 alone never produces an lc verdict, n=1 MDE 11.1): lc_total 27, mean_score 4.762, trim1 4.057, vs comparator mean 29.0 / pooled sd 2.80. Certification could not be completed as sealed because the Kaggle API returned a 0-byte kernel log on two independent pulls while every other retained pull carries 250KB+, so the log-marker certification is unevaluable and strictly reads INFRA DEATH (death #1; two parks the arm).
lesson: DELIVERY-WITHOUT-USE, 5th instance: the channel was armed, reachable and present in the running code, and the model essentially never touched it. An affordance advertised ONLY inside a tool-call JSON schema description is not advertised -- the transcripts show the model reading the stock guidance block ('Cross-level notes:' 159 hits, stock text, not ours) while ignoring our clause. This is direct evidence that the campaign's open question 'forgetting REFUTED or DELIVERY-WITHOUT-USE?' lands on DELIVERY-WITHOUT-USE. Two operational lessons ride along: (1) a COMPLETED kernel that is never pulled is indistinguishable from one that never ran -- P1 sat unread while the weekend lanes planned to spend Monday slot 2 on its seed 2; (2) benchmark.json 'label' does NOT identify an arm -- P1's artifact and the certified field floor's carry the byte-identical 'anim-20260807-anim-25g-p1', where the trailing -p1 is PASS 1, not the P1 arm.
consequence: Monday slot 2 must NOT be P1 seed 2. A DELIVERY FAILURE seals to re-scope-never-re-read; the INFRA reading seals to re-run-not-advance. Both refuse seed 2. Recommended: Mon slot 1 = C1 cadence-effort seed 1 (unchanged, anchor verified present exactly once offline); Mon slot 2 = C1 seed 2 or P2 seed 1, coordinator's call.
